facts.fact: The Minister of Urbanism and Habitat chaired a meeting on the E-Cadastre project, run with ANSI, which aims to set up a national, digital, integrated cadastral system on a single platform.

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Urbanisme et de l'Habitat with ANSI

facts.fact: The minister of urbanism and housing said a single cadastre is being delivered through the E-Cadastre project developed with ANSI and financed by the World Bank PVI, with cadastral digitalisation a priority.

systems.owner: Ministere de l'Urbanisme et de l'Habitat
